title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

  • Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

  • Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

  • Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

  • Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

  • Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

  • Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

  • Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

  • Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits

  • Competitive base compensation

  • Annual bonus potential

  • Health benefits effective on start date

  • Health & Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well-being available on start date

  • 401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary

  • Technology setup

  • Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. We will also never ask for you to purchase anything; nor will we ever interview you via text message. About the job

title: Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)
description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident.

The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist.

Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call.

Thousands of teams, from AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering organizations like LinkedIn, Citi and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Our stack is AI (Claude, Codex, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We don't filter on programming language. If you ship full-stack with AI, you'll pick ours up. We ship to prod all day, every day, practice Agile (not scrum), keep meetings low and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

 

What you'll do

  • Shape a product from early stage to strategic. You'll be involved early in how we build incident response out as a platform, technically and on the product side. That means a lot of ownership, influence and visibility.

  • Build the foundation first. Incident management, status pages, on-call, and tight integration with the rest of Checkly. For at least the first six months this is solid product engineering. AI-assisted incident response comes once the foundation is in place.

  • Build and ship with AI. Coding agents are how you work: exploring solutions, scaffolding, refactoring, testing and debugging.

  • Talk to the people on call. You'll be directly involved in customer conversations. You'll learn how responders work under pressure and turn that into what we build next.

  • Find the right problems to solve. In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

  • Own your work end to end. From the first idea to rollout to how it behaves in production. You'll join the on-call and support rotations like everyone else.

 

What you should have

  • You've built incident management, on-call, alerting or status page products before. You know what responders need from a tool when something breaks at 3am.

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can drive a product area, not just pick up tickets. You make decisions without perfect information, and you ask for input when it counts. You have opinions about what we should build and why, and you change your mind when someone makes a better case.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • You share work early. Drafts, rough MVPs and half-finished docs go out for feedback before they’re polished. In an async team, that’s how good ideas get better fast.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without waiting for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, team meetups or conferences.

 

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

 

How we build with AI

Don’t take our word for it. Here’s what that looks like in practice, written by the team:

  • Checkly and the agentic software layer: Hannes on why the CLI is how agents use software, including running monitoring and incidents.

  • Your software factory stops at deploy: Stefan on what happens after deploy, when a failing check should kick off the fix.

  • We let AI agents rewrite a 92M-message-a-day service in Go: Eddie on porting a core service with an agent, and zero incidents.

  • Why I built my own AI agent orchestration tool: Immanuel on running 10 to 20 coding agents at once.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

 

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €107k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

 

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

title: Recruiter – Quereinstieg aus Vertrieb & Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden.

Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben.

Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach.

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen

Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhängige Vergütung motivieren – und der seinen Erfolg selbst mitgestalten will.

Zeig uns, wie du Menschen gewinnst

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein konkretes Beispiel: Wie hast du passende Menschen erreicht, ihr Interesse geweckt und daraus ein Ergebnis entwickelt? Das kann eine Besetzung sein oder – bei deinem Quereinstieg – ein passendes Beispiel aus Vertrieb oder Marketing. Bitte ohne vertrauliche Personen- oder Kundendaten.

Wir möchten verstehen, wie du denkst und arbeitest – und dich persönlich kennenlernen.

Quellen nachvollziehbar halten und unsichere Ergebnisse zur manuellen Prüfung kennzeichnen.

  • KI-gestütztes Arbeiten: Wiederkehrende Aufgaben erkennen, geeignete KI-Werkzeuge einsetzen und einfache Automatisierungen erproben. Ergebnisse auf Richtigkeit, Nutzen und Datenschutz prüfen.

title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
description:
01 · Why this role exists

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Behind every megawatt hour our customers save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies, together around 2% of Europe's energy demand, make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works like a digital colleague. The colleagues we need most are the ones we haven't found yet.

Finding them is your job. We're about 15 people and growing fast, with open roles in engineering, value engineering and the public sector. There is no recruiting playbook yet and no HR department. You'll write the playbook and decide who RIZM becomes.

02 · Meet Diana, your teammate

Hi, I'm Diana. I run recruiting at RIZM today, 20 hours a week next to my studies, together with Lorenz, our Founders Associate. We've built the first funnel, but there are more good people out there than two part-time recruiters can reach. That's why we need you: someone who owns hiring full-time and takes it further than we can. You'll have Josh, our co-founder, as your sparring partner for offers and tricky decisions. Questions before you apply? Message me on LinkedIn.

Diana

03 · What you'll do

  • Own hiring end to end: From the first message to the signed offer, for every open role at RIZM.

  • Build the system: Design our process, stations, scorecards and tools from scratch, and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board.

  • Find the right people: Source engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network.

  • Win people over: Run first conversations, tell our story well and make every candidate feel looked after, even when the answer is no.

  • Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI, and always know where the funnel gets stuck.

  • Get us seen: Careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships.

04 · What you bring

  • Experience: A few years in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in startups or tech, including technical profiles.

  • People sense: You spot potential that isn't on the CV and talk to engineers as equals.

  • AI-native: You try new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things faster.

  • Builder drive: You'd rather create structures than step into them, independently, reliably and fast.

  • Ownership: You care about results, not activity, and you're motivated by being paid for them.

  • Languages: Fluent German and English, written and spoken.

05 · Why you should apply now

You're the first full-time recruiter. What you build stays.

  • Pay that follows your impact: A fixed salary plus uncapped variable pay and equity. Every hire you make shows up directly in what you earn.

  • Direct line to the founders: Hiring is their top priority.

  • A network that moves you forward: Sparring and learning with the networks of our investors Point 9 and Earlybird.

  • Once a year, we get out: A team offsite with inspiring guests.

  • Stay fit: Urban Sports Club membership.

06 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest lines on these two questions.

  1. What's the best hire you ever made or helped make, and how did you find that person?

  2. Write the first message you'd send to a senior engineer who isn't looking for a new job. Five lines at most.

After that:

  • Intro call: 15 minutes on video with Diana to get to know each other.

  • Case study: A short, practical recruiting case you work on at home.

  • Case presentation: 30 minutes online with Lorenz and Diana.

  • Meet the founders: At our office. Then we decide together.

title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) · 11 Gameshow-Filialen · Remote mit Reisen
description:
Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Start sofort · Firmenwagen · Berichtet an den Gründer

Du führst 80+ Werkstudenten in 11 Filialen in ganz Deutschland. Filialleiter gibt es nicht. Du arbeitest von zu Hause, bist jede Woche in einer Filiale und greifst, wenn nötig, auch am Wochenende ein.

Gamer - Die Gameshow

Bei uns wird ein Ausflug mit Freunden oder Kollegen zur Gameshow. Aus über 20.000 Google Bewertungen haben wir 4,9 Sterne. 2027 wachsen wir weiter stark mit vielen neuen Filialen.

Spiele, Technik und Software sind unsere Stärke. Der Betrieb unserer Filialen ist es bisher nicht. Trotz guter Bewertungen zeigt das Feedback unserer Gäste, dass es vor Ort zu oft hakt, z. B. bei der Sauberkeit und beim Wohlfühlen. Uns fehlt die Erfahrung, Strukturen und Abläufe so aufzubauen, dass sie auch funktionieren, wenn niemand von uns da ist. Diese Erfahrung bringst du mit.

Deine Aufgabe

  • Der Betrieb unserer 11 eigenen Filialen liegt bei dir: Teams, Abläufe und alles, was nötig ist, um Gäste vor Ort glücklich zu machen.
  • Du führst die mehr als 80 Werkstudenten: von der Auswahl über das Training bis zum Abschied.
  • Du baust die Strukturen auf, die heute fehlen. Welche das sind, findest du selbst heraus.
  • Du bringst neue Filialen operativ an den Start.
  • Du startest nicht allein: In deinem Team ist ein starker Operations Manager, der unsere Filialen und Werkstudenten sehr gut kennt.
  • Die Richtung stimmst du direkt mit unserem Gründer ab.

Daran merken wir, dass es klappt

  • Gäste loben die Filiale, statt sie zu bemängeln. Auch an einem vollen Samstag.
  • Die Teams arbeiten auch dann nach Standard, wenn niemand zuschaut.
  • Gute Werkstudenten bleiben und werben andere an.
  • Der NPS in jeder Filiale steigt deutlich, die Personalkosten dagegen steigen nicht.

Der schwierigste Teil

  • 11 Filialen, ein Besuch pro Woche: Jede Filiale siehst du nur einmal im Quartal.
  • Dazwischen führst du über Systeme, Telefon und das Feedback der Gäste, das du in Echtzeit siehst.
  • Standards zu entwickeln ist der leichte Teil. Der schwierige ist, dass sie auch ohne dich gelten.

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Remote-First ohne Headquarter.
  • Wir schreiben lieber, als zu telefonieren. Entscheidungen fallen in Minuten per Chat, nicht in einem Meeting.
  • Kein Ego. Kein Bullshit. Wir kommunizieren immer direkt und ehrlich.
  • Leistung zählt mehr als jeder Titel. Wir arbeiten wie ein erfolgreiches Sport-Team. Nur wer Vollgas für unseren Erfolg gibt, ist Teil des Teams.
  • Fehler sind komplett okay, jeder aber bitte nur einmal.
  • Technik vor Personal: Was eine Software erledigen kann, soll kein Mensch machen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du führst über die Auswahl der richtigen Leute, gutes Training, klare Erwartungen und konsequente Kontrolle, nicht über Angst.
  • Du packst mit an. Siehst du vor Ort ein Problem, bist du ein Teil der Lösung. Danach sorgst du dafür, dass es nicht wiederkommt.
  • Die Klimaanlage fällt aus und zwei Mitarbeiter sind krank: Das gibt dir Energie, weil etwas los ist. Auch beim zwanzigsten Mal noch.
  • Unsere wichtigsten Tage sind das Wochenende. Auch dann fühlst du dich verantwortlich. Es zählt nicht, wie viele Stunden du arbeitest, sondern dass die Filialen laufen.
  • Du weißt aus Erfahrung, wie Strukturen und Abläufe funktionieren, die auch ohne dich laufen. Ob du sie selbst aufgebaut oder übernommen hast, ist zweitrangig.
  • Ob Hotellerie, Gastro oder Retail: Aus welcher Branche du kommst, ist egal. Dein Wille, hart für Erfolg zu arbeiten, ist es nicht.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gut Englisch.

Was wir bieten

  • Das Gegenteil zum Konzern: schnelle Entscheidungen und viel Raum zur Gestaltung. Wir bauen, statt nur zu verwalten.
  • Wir investieren sofort in gute Ideen. Ein neues Feature in der Software? Ist in wenigen Tagen da.
  • Ein gutes Gehalt, dazu ein Bonus, der vom Feedback der Gäste abhängt (NPS).
  • Firmenwagen. Und natürlich alle Reisekosten.
  • Arbeitest du am Wochenende, nimmst du entsprechende Zeit unter der Woche frei.
  • Uns ist egal, wo du wohnst, solange du von dort alle Filialen gut erreichst.
  • Du bist Teil des Führungsteams und berichtest direkt an unseren Gründer Timo.

So läuft die Bewerbung

Etwa 10 Minuten, ohne Anschreiben. Passt dein Gehaltswunsch nicht zu unserem Rahmen, sagen wir es dir sofort.

Danach: schriftliche Aufgabe (etwa 80 Minuten, fünf Tage Zeit), ein Gespräch mit Timo und eins mit Daniel, Referenzen, ein bezahlter Samstag in einer unserer Filialen, Angebot.

Hallo! Wir sind Applysia, ein HR-Tech-Unternehmen aus Münster. Unsere Software für die Personalauswahl wird von führenden Unternehmen und Beratungen weltweit genutzt, um Assessment-Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten.

Mit unserer Lösung vereinfachen und verbessern wir Assessment-Center nachhaltig, um Potenziale in Menschen vorurteilsfrei zu erkennen, zu fördern und zu entfalten. Mit Kompetenz, Vielseitigkeit und Engagement gestalten wir das Assessment des 21. Jahrhunderts. Unser Ziel: HR-Prozesse digitalisieren und Auswahlverfahren fairer, nachhaltiger und effizienter machen.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Fullstack Developer treibst du zusammen mit uns die Entwicklung unseres Backends, Frontends und unserer API voran. Du setzt neue Features eigenständig um und bist aktiv in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen eingebunden.

Uns ist es wichtig, eine Applikation zu entwickeln, die nicht nur leistungsfähig, sondern auch für jede*n Nutzer*in leicht verständlich und angenehm zu bedienen ist.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits mit modernen Frameworks wie Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot oder Laravel entwickelt. Rails-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber wir legen vor allem Wert auf deine umfassende Fullstack-Kompetenz.
  • Frontend-Entwicklung bereitet dir Freude. Wir nutzen Rails in Kombination mit Vue.js, um interaktive Features umzusetzen.
  • Du bist vertraut mit AWS oder hast Interesse, dich in AWS-Technologien einzuarbeiten.
  • Testing liegt dir am Herzen, egal ob Unit-, Integrations- oder End-to-End-Tests (z. B. mit Cypress).
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Arbeiten in agilen Teams mit einem CI/CD-Prozess und idealerweise mit GitHub Actions.
  • Du hast den Gesamtüberblick über die Applikation und liebst die Arbeit sowohl am Backend als auch am Frontend.
  • Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen und Technologien ein und löst komplexe Probleme kreativ.
  • Du möchtest ein Produkt maßgeblich mitgestalten, triffst gerne technische Entscheidungen und hast die Bedürfnisse der Kund*innen immer im Blick.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du bestimmst, wann du am produktivsten bist.
  • Freie Wahl der Arbeitsmittel: Mac, mechanische Tastatur, Plugins, IDE – du entscheidest, was du brauchst, und wir sorgen dafür.
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents: Wir legen Wert auf eine gute Unternehmenskultur – wir arbeiten zusammen, nicht nur nebeneinander.
  • Von Anfang an Verantwortung übernehmen, unterstützt durch regelmäßiges Feedback.
  • Raum für eigene Ideen, Erfahrungen und Eigeninitiative.

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab

Uns ist ein transparenter und fairer Auswahlprozess wichtig. Wir möchten dich und deine Fähigkeiten bestmöglich kennenlernen – gleichzeitig sollst auch du ein gutes Gefühl dafür bekommen, wer wir sind und wie wir arbeiten. Deshalb besteht unser Prozess aus drei klar strukturierten Schritten:

1. Kurzes Telefoninterview (ca. 30 Minuten)

In einem ersten Gespräch lernen wir uns gegenseitig kennen. Wir stellen dir die Position, unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise vor und beantworten alle deine Fragen. Gleichzeitig interessiert uns, was dich motiviert, welche Erfahrungen du mitbringst und was du dir von deiner nächsten Rolle wünschst.
Warum? – Der persönliche Eindruck zählt. Wir möchten herausfinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen – fachlich und menschlich.

2. Eignungsdiagnostik (ca. 2–3 Stunden, flexibel einteilbar)

In diesem Schritt bitten wir dich, drei Bausteine zu absolvieren:

  • Coding Challege: Du kannst deine Coding Skills zeigen.
  • Einen kognitiven Leistungstest, der hilft, dein analytisches Denkvermögen objektiv zu erfassen.
  • Einen kurzen Persönlichkeitsfragebogen, der Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie du arbeitest, kommunizierst und Probleme angehst.

Warum? – Wir glauben an eine fundierte und faire Entscheidungsgrundlage. Unsere Diagnostik-Tools helfen uns (und dir), besser zu verstehen, wo deine Stärken liegen und wie du am besten ins Team passt – ganz ohne Bias.

3. Technisches Interview (ca. 60–90 Minuten)

In einem vertiefenden Gespräch mit unseren Entwickler*innen schauen wir uns gemeinsam die Ergebnisse der Challenge an, besprechen Lösungswege und tauschen uns über Architektur, Code-Qualität und deinen Entwicklungsstil aus. Dabei ist uns wichtig, dass du Fragen stellen kannst und wir auf Augenhöhe miteinander sprechen.

Warum? – Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, wie du Probleme angehst und welche Perspektiven du in unser Team einbringen kannst. Gleichzeitig bekommst du einen realistischen Eindruck davon, wie wir als Team arbeiten und mit welchen Technologien wir umgehen.

As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience - the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience.

You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation.

 
 

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management.

  • Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability.

  • Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort.

  • Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle.

  • Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.).

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks.

  • Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

  • Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations.

  • Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams.

  • Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments.

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles.

  • Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams.

  • Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset.

  • Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion.

Nice to have

  • Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring.

  • Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

  • One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

  • Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

  • Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

  • Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

  • A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

  • Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Ausbildung

  • Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik) oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang

  • Du verfügst über eine offene und klare Kommunikationsweise, arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams und beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift sowie Englisch auf gutem Niveau

  • Zukunftsbranche: Du erhältst einen unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz in der Medizintechnik
  • Miteinander: Gemeinsam für innovative Medizintechnik
  • Onboarding: Du startest mit einer intensiven und strukturierten Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Teammitglieder sowie durch unsere Veranstaltungen BE Link und Hey LINK
  • Work-Life-Balance: 37,5 Wochenstunden | 30 Tage Urlaub | mobiles Arbeiten
  • Zukunft? Gesichert!: Wir sorgen zusammen für Deine Zukunft z.B. mit einer betriebliche Altersvorsorge inkl. Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • C orporate B enefits : Nutze zahlreiche Mitarbeitenden-Rabatte bei zahlreichen Kooperationspartnern
  • Mobilität: 25% Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket | kostenlose Parkplätze | überdachter Fahrradparkplatz | Bikeleasing
  • Umzugsstress?: Nicht mit uns - nach Absprache übernehmen wir gern die Kosten Deines Umzugs mit einer steuerfreien Umzugspauschale bis zu einer Höhe von 964€
  • Vergütung: Empfehlungsbonus für neu geworbene Mitarbeitende

Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do.

What you'll build and own

  • Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on.

  • Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction.

  • Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows.

  • Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling to compress iteration cycles without sacrificing correctness.

  • Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services.

  • Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions.

  • Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras.

Your experience

  • At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment.

  • A track record of building and scaling distributed systems - you have seen things break at scale and know how to design so they do not.

  • Experience working on or closely with platform or enablement teams: shared libraries, internal tooling, developer experience or API gateways.

Nice to have

  • Experience building SDKs or developer-facing platform services consumed by other engineering teams.

  • Prior work in a high-growth startup or scale-up (roughly 50-500 people) where you had to set standards, not just follow them.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

In February, we raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to make our applications, and the platform they run on, secure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work inside our engineering teams, review how our platforms are designed, find where they are weak, and help get them fixed.

Much of the job is setting up practices we don't yet have. You'll make threat modelling a normal part of how we plan and build, introduce vulnerability management across our applications and AWS infrastructure, and automate security testing at every stage of the delivery pipeline. We want checks that run on every change, so engineers find problems early and fix them in their own teams without everything having to route through you.

We're investing in AI-assisted engineering across the company, and we have a working group exploring where it helps us build better software. Security is part of that work from the start. You'll join the working group, set the guardrails and automated checks that hold every change to the same standard however it was written, and use the same tools in your own work.

Job responsibilities

  • Make threat modelling a standard part of how engineering plans and builds, run it on the highest-risk work, and train teams to do their own

  • Review the security architecture of our platforms end to end, and turn what you find into prioritised work

  • Set up and run vulnerability management across application code and AWS infrastructure, with a clear severity model and agreed fix times

  • Build automated security testing into every stage of the pipeline, covering secrets scanning, static and dynamic testing and dependency checks, tuned so it catches real problems without getting in the way

  • Run internal penetration testing as a continuing activity, using AI tools to test features as they ship, and coordinate external testing

  • Put AWS security guardrails in place as Terraform, and keep configuration from drifting

  • Set up how we manage and rotate secrets, and build controls for our software supply chain

  • Test that customer data stays properly separated between tenants, and keep production data out of non-production

  • Build the guardrails for agentic engineering, covering what agents can access, how they are sandboxed, which tools and connectors they can use, and the checks agent-written code has to pass before it merges

  • Give engineers practical security advice day to day, and fix issues yourself when that is the fastest way to get them fixed

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Strong product or application security background built on software engineering experience, and comfortable reading, writing and reviewing code

  • Experience running threat modelling and getting engineering teams to adopt it as their own

  • Experience introducing vulnerability management that engineering teams work to

  • Hands-on with security testing across the pipeline, including secrets scanning, SAST, DAST and SCA, and with tuning those tools to cut noise

  • Experience penetration testing web applications and APIs

  • Good working knowledge of AWS security, including access and identity, networking and encryption, and able to read, review and write Terraform

  • Use AI coding agents in your daily work, and can show security tooling, tests or review checks you've built with them

  • Understand the security risks that agents bring, including prompt injection, over-broad permissions and untrusted dependencies

  • A developer-first outlook, where success looks like engineers choosing the secure option and owning their own security

  • Clear communicator who can turn security risk into practical decisions for technical and non-technical colleagues

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Built security guardrails for teams working with coding agents or automated software delivery

  • Worked on software that serves many customers from shared infrastructure, and the data-separation questions that come with it

  • Worked in a functional language such as Haskell, or built security checks for a language the standard tools cover poorly

  • Worked in InsurTech, FinTech or another regulated industry

  • Helped build security practices from an early stage

  • Spent time training and coaching engineers on security

Benefits

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Product Lead for two of our largest categories - established businesses that serve millions of customers and represent a significant share of company revenue. You will lead a dedicated cross-functional team, owning top-line business growth and a strategic roadmap to achieve results. You’ll own the end to end customer journey: how customers find us, the acquisition funnel, and their experience on treatment.

The core of the job is disciplined, high-velocity experimentation. We’re looking for someone who is systematic about finding those opportunities, rigorous about testing them, and uses learnings to inform the roadmap.

This role also sits inside a broader shift in how our product development organization works. We’ve rebuilt our operating model around AI, and are especially reinventing how AI can drive growth experimentation. This role sits at the center of that.

You Will:

  • Own growth targets, including new customer acquisition and retention

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap for the team, sequencing work according to expected impact and making tradeoffs

  • Build and run a continuous experimentation program with cross-functional partners: maintain a prioritized hypothesis backlog, keep multiple tests in flight, define success metrics and guardrails before launch, and hold a high bar on how results are interpreted

  • Improve the end-to-end customer experience across acquisition surfaces, onboarding, checkout and pricing presentation, refills, and long-term subscription retention

  • Communicate the state of the business to leadership and cross-functional partners on a regular cadence through clear written updates on metrics, experiments, and learnings

You Have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including several years in a growth, funnel, or monetization role where you owned business metrics

  • Deep fluency in experimentation and data

  • An established practice of working with AI agents in your day-to-day product work, and a clear point of view on what that changes about how teams operate and what products should be

  • Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you.Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving environment

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

title: Senior Partner, ER, Policy & Compliance
description:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

 

About the Role:

Build and mature Sitecore’s Employee Relations and Investigations practice, creating the operating model, investigation standards, policy framework, governance and practical toolkits needed to drive consistency and confidence across the business. Serve as the subject-matter expert for complex employee relations matters and workplace investigations, partnering with business leaders, People Business Partners and Legal to ensure fair, thorough and risk-conscious outcomes. Use case insights, early intervention, manager enablement and preventative practices to address issues before they escalate, strengthen working relationships and continuously improve the employee experience

 

What You'll Do:

Employee Relations

  • Develop and implement the ER framework covering intake, assessment, investigation, escalation, resolution and follow-up, with clear responsibilities, decision points, guidance and templates for managers/HRBPs

  • Partner with managers and HRBPs to recognise emerging concerns, intervene early; facilitate informal resolution and mediation where appropriate to resolve issues before they escalate

  • Independently manage grievances and workplace concerns; lead or coordinate fair investigations with clear documentation and evidence-based findings

  • Partner with managers and HRBPs on recommendations, decisions and communication, involving Legal and other specialists as appropriate and escalating sensitive or high-risk matters

  • Maintain accurate, confidential records; use case trends to identify recurring issues and preventative action. Build manager and HRBP capability through practical guidance, coaching and training

HR policies

  • Own the policy lifecycle: identify gaps, draft and update policies, and coordinate consultation, approval, communication and review to support business needs, consistent employee experiences and applicable employment requirements

  • Partner with Legal, HRBPs and subject matter experts to balance a consistent company approach with local requirements; maintain a central library with clear ownership, version control and review dates

  • Create accessible guidance, templates and communications for employees and managers, using employee feedback and case experience to improve policy clarity and application

Employment compliance

  • Maintain a compliance tracker with Legal and local HR partners covering requirements, actions, owners and deadlines; coordinate legislation implementation through policy, process, guidance and training updates

  • Review ER processes and policy application, identify gaps, agree corrective actions and track completion. Coordinate policy acknowledgements and relevant mandatory training, maintaining completion records

  • Support employment-related audits and information requests with clear records and track agreed follow-up actions.

 

What you will bring:

  • Substantial relevant ER experience, typically around eight years, or equivalent relevant education and experience; independent management of complex, sensitive cases from assessment through resolution

  • Experience in early intervention, manager coaching, informal resolution, ER process development and drafting, reviewing and implementing HR policies

  • Strong working knowledge of employment legislation in supported jurisdictions, judgement about seeking specialist legal advice, and experience across countries or partnering with local specialists on different employment requirements.

  • Sound judgement in assessing incomplete or conflicting information and making practical recommendations; strong investigation, documentation and communication skills, explaining sensitive issues clearly and influencing stakeholders.

  • Ability to build workable processes while managing an active caseload and competing priorities

  • Experience partnering closely with in-house Legal or external employment counsel

Nice to have:

  • A qualification or background in employment law, legal studies, or employment legislation and regulatory compliance

  • Litigation experience

A relevant HR qualification or professional accreditation

Why Join Sitecore?

At Sitecore, you'll have the opportunity to shape and strengthen how we manage employee relations, support our leaders and create consistent employee experience across a global organization.

This is a highly visible role where you will have the opportunity to influence people practices, build scalable frameworks and partner with stakeholders across the business, making a tangible contribution to both our culture and organizational effectiveness.

 

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore:

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.
